subject: geography
title: Compass and Direction
welcome_lead: Which way is north? Master the compass and 8-point directions to navigate like a pro.
meta_desc: KS3 Geography adventure on compass directions including 8-point compass.
final_note: Brilliant! You can now use the 8-point compass.

concepts.def: Tool showing direction using a magnetic needle.
North, East, South, West — main directions.
Direction toward the North Pole, 0 or 360°.

walkthroughs.body_html: North, East, South, West — remember Never Eat Shredded Wheat! North = 0°, East = 90°, South = 180°, West = 270°.
Add NE, SE, SW, NW between the cardinals. NE = 45°, SE = 135°, SW = 225°, NW = 315°.
A bearing is the angle from north, measured clockwise. Always written as 3 digits, e.g. 045° (NE), 270° (W).
